basic_profile.bio: Dave is a seasoned Redditor from New Zealand with a passion for the outdoors and a knack for technology. He spends his weekends kayaking or fishing in the picturesque waters around his home. During the week, Dave works as a freelance software developer, specializing in blockchain technology. He's been married for five years to his partner, who shares his love for nature. Dave is an early riser, often online from 6 AM to 9 AM and then again in the evenings after 7 PM local time. He dislikes crowded places and prefers one-on-one interactions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Dave has a diverse knowledge base, primarily centered around blockchain and cryptocurrency, which he learned through a combination of formal education (a degree in Computer Science) and extensive self-teaching. Additionally, his love for the outdoors is backed by years of personal experience and community involvement in local environmental initiatives.
